capabilities: Render ABC notation blocks with playback, tempo and transposition controls
Render strumming patterns with stroke tokens and animated playback
Render chord sheets with guitar, ukulele and piano diagrams, transposition and lyrics translation
Write chord progressions as Roman numerals or chord names with harmonic-function coloring and a rendered score
Capture MIDI keyboard input into notes and export .mid files
extras: Makes network requests only for lyrics translation (Google Translate) and song import from Ultimate Guitar or GuitarTuna links; imported lyrics are for personal use and subject to the source sites' terms. Packages (ABC, strumming, chords, progression, MIDI, import) can each be toggled independently in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render playable music notation, chord diagrams or strumming patterns inside notes, so musicians must keep songs elsewhere.

relations.evidence: Any abcjs visual parameter is accepted.
Numerals follow the RomanText chord grammar, the standard used by music21.
paste a link to a chord page on a supported site
Translation uses Google Translate (internet connection required)

summary: Renders ABC notation, strumming patterns, chord sheets and Roman numeral progressions in notes, with playback, MIDI capture and song import.
